ops.text: lr adds the sparse worktree with plain git, and Orca 1.4.247 registers a plain-git worktree only when its per-repo scan cache is rebuilt, about every five minutes on the monorepo (16 scans 06:48-07:54 PT Nov 6, median gap 311 s); no CLI verb adopts an existing path or invalidates that cache, while Orca's own worktree create registers at once and its RPC already accepts sparseCheckout.directories that the CLI does not expose.
